features.name: Structured note intelligence
features.description: Extract note type, lifecycle, tags, links, questions, actions, relationships, duplicates, and contradictions into a reviewable queue.
features.spec: AI suggestions must be additive, source-grounded, reviewable, and stored outside the Markdown source until approved.
features.plan: Keep Markdown as the source of truth; analyze changed notes through ai_ref_sync; persist pending suggestions in SQLite; expose review IDs and approval actions.

features.name: AI's Ref refinement
features.description: Generate a concise senior-level reflection that identifies one defensible, non-obvious optimization for a changed note.
features.spec: Never paraphrase generic best practices; require mechanism, tradeoff, falsifiable experiment, and a condition where the optimization should not be used.
features.plan: Run CDC refinement on new or changed notes, write an AI's Ref section, and index it as high-signal retrieval context.

features.name: AI-ref retrieval enrichment
features.description: Use AI's Ref as a separate high-signal retrieval context while preserving the original note content.
features.spec: AI-ref chunks must be labeled separately, carry a retrieval priority, and be removed through the same source-level CDC path.
features.plan: Mark typed chunks with content_role=ai_ref and retrieval_priority=1.25; emit a companion vector in the legacy sync engine.

verification.description: Run chunker, schema, and sync tests

features.name: Human approval loop
features.description: Deliver pending suggestions through Telegram and apply accepted structured metadata to Markdown notes.
features.spec: Approval must use a stable review ID, reject stale notes, preserve prose, and allow rejection without source mutation.
features.plan: Show IDs in daily review output; support /approve_ref and /reject_ref; re-index approved note changes through CDC.

features.name: Published Query Brain
features.description: Provide a browser query page for published brain notes only.
features.spec: The public Jekyll query index must include only notes with published: true.
features.plan: Generate a static browser index from the published brain collection and filter locally by text, type, and tag.

verification.description: Check the published-only query template and browser script

features.name: Daily Vietnamese life quote
features.description: Send one original, practical Vietnamese life quote through the existing scheduled Telegram workflow.
features.spec: Output one concise quote grounded in the knowledge base, without attribution, filler, or story structure.
features.plan: Keep the existing 11:00 Vietnam schedule and bot delivery path while changing the generator prompt and output contract.

verification.description: Compile the Vietnamese daily quote generator

features.name: Spec-driven agent harness
features.description: Synchronize agent instructions, hard constraints, task conventions, feature specifications, verification commands, and end-of-turn artifacts.
features.spec: Agent work must use explicit F/SPEC/P/TC references, hard constraints, executable verification, and end-of-turn synchronization before handoff.
features.plan: Provide AGENT_HARNESS.md, spec-driven agent configuration, reusable validation scripts, task-list conventions, and the end-of-turn-sync skill.

verification.description: Validate the registry and agent harness scripts

features.name: Optimized knowledge-base sync container
features.description: Build and run the longddl-kb sync pipeline from one Compose-managed CPU-only optimized image.
features.spec: The main Compose file must use the optimized sync-pipeline image, the runtime must complete a CDC sync successfully, and the obsolete sync image must not remain.
features.plan: Use a multi-stage Python build, install CPU-only PyTorch, cache the embedding model in the image, exclude build context noise, and reference the image from the main Compose file.

verification.description: Verify the Compose image, active container identity, clean exit, and optimized image presence
command: test "$(docker compose -f longddl-kb/docker-compose.yml config --images | grep '^longddl-kb-sync:optimized$')" = 'longddl-kb-sync:optimized' && docker image inspect longddl-kb-sync:optimized >/dev/null && test "$(docker inspect --format '{{.Config.Image}} {{.State.ExitCode}} {{.State.OOMKilled}}' longddl_sync_pipeline)" = 'longddl-kb-sync:optimized 0 false' && ! docker image inspect longddl-kb_kb-sync:latest >/dev/null 2>&1
